messages:
maria: Quick check — planning a 02:00 UTC change window tonight for v3.4.2. Objectives: rolling canary -> staggered edge -> full. Need final pin, rollback owners, and smoke checklist.
ken: I'm on rollback owner unless someone else volunteers. :hand:
    I'll be reachable on call and pager.
tara: ack. I'll own canary monitoring and release notes update.
yuri: I'll run the smoke suite 10m after canary and tag regressions in the evals dashboard.
maria: deploy-bot will post the scheduled job in ~30min. Reminder: freeze starts 01:30 UTC. Only emergency fixes after that.
deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout: v3.4.2 -> canary at 02:00 UTC. Pins: model:v3.4.2-pin3, runtime:stable-2026-03.
ops-bot: Change window reminder set for 01:30 UTC to #eng-releases, #sre.
ken: Quick rollback plan: if latency > 2x or error rate > 1% sustained for 3min, execute rollback to v3.4.1 and disable traffic shift. Rollback command:
```
./deploy rollback --to model:v3.4.1 --scope full --reason "post-launch degradation"
```
maria: Approving the rollback thresholds. Also add a canary pin override path: if canary fails, we hold and run manual review, not immediate full rollback unless infra broken.
tara: Release notes draft pushed to the docs repo: https://git.internal/redwood/releases/v3.4.2. Section "Known issues" lists the KV cache warmup caveat.
yuri: smoke checklist (short):
- login flow (10 users)
- api /generate end-to-end (5 prompts)
- latency percentile check (p50/p95)
- embedding job sanity
I'll post failures to thread.
maria: who will post the final GO/NO-GO? we need one comms message at T-15.
ken: I'll post GO/NO-GO at T-15 based on canary health and infra signals. If I'm offline, @tara to override.
maria: ok locking pins and owners. Everyone, please avoid post-freeze merges unless flagged by me.
tara: noted. I'll run the release-note announcement once GO is given. :rocket:
yuri: smoke runner ready. ping me when canary is live.
deploy-bot: Canary to 10% traffic started at 02:02 UTC. Job id: 2026-03-20-43123-canary
maria: canary live — monitoring panel up: https://console/redwood/dashboards/canary-v3.4.2
ken: seeing a small spike in p95 but within limits. continuing watch.
ops-bot: Alert rule set: latency_p95 > 1800ms for 2min -> slack alert and page.
yuri: smoke tests: login ok, generate ok, embeddings slow for one shard (investigating).
tara: holding GO until embeddings shard stabilized. tagging the rollout.
maria: hold acknowledged. rolling back canary to avoid wider impact.
deploy-bot: Canary rollback initiated to v3.4.1 by ken at 02:11 UTC. Rolling back traffic and clearing pins.
ken: rollback succeeded. postmortem follow-up: we'll run a regression test on embeddings quantization path and delay broad rollout.
maria: thanks everyone. We'll schedule a short postmortem + replan tomorrow 09:30 PT. Closing this thread once notes posted.
